purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century RBGE Walker Arnott, NHM William Smith, and NHMW Grunow collection nodes.
guards: Preserve former institutional custody and current custody separately when historic collections have moved between repositories.
For mixed-period institutional portals, enumerate only records tied to the named nineteenth-century collector or collection filter; never inherit the whole museum slide count.
Preserve original sample/accession/slide numbering systems because they provide crosswalks to catalogues, drawings, publications, and replicate sets.

adapters.institution_scope: Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh historical diatom collections
adapters.target: Walker Arnott collection page and downloadable Large/Small series catalogues
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture Large-tube and S-prefixed Small-tube identifiers, current RBGE sequence, former Glasgow/SMBA custody, correspondence-derived material, isotype status, and links to NHM-held historical catalogues.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Data Portal
adapters.target: named nineteenth-century collector microscope-preparation records within collection-specimens
adapters.promotion_rule: Enumerate only records where the named collector/recorded-by filter remains explicit; capture catalogue number, barcode, collection date, type status, locality, occurrence ID and IIIF metadata.

adapters.institution_scope: Naturhistorisches Museum Wien Grunow diatom collection
adapters.target: specialist collection guide for Grunow slides, accession books, exsiccatae, samples and drawings
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve accession-book sample number, slide number, original-sample relation, drawing relation, published-set identity and current cabinet structure; do not collapse samples, slides and exsiccata envelopes into one item type.
